name: Great Apes
description: Great apes are large, tailless primate Mammals: the orangutans, gorillas, chimpanzees and bonobos, and humans.$(br2)They are intelligent and long-lived, with long arms and grasping hands, and on the ground most of them walk on all fours, resting their weight on their knuckles or fists.$(br2)The living non-human apes are found only in the tropical forests of Africa and Southeast Asia.
